title: Announcing SOC 2 Type II
summary: Heroic Labs has achieved SOC 2 Type II compliance certification, providing independent validation that our security controls meet enterprise standards.
body_text: We’re pleased to announce that Heroic Labs has achieved SOC 2 Type II compliance certification, as validated by independent auditors at Johanson Group LLP . What This Means for You Game studios trust us with their player data, multiplayer infrastructure, and LiveOps systems. This certification provides independent validation that our security controls meet enterprise standards, tested over months of continuous operation, not just reviewed on paper. SOC 2 Type II compliance is table stakes for enterprise game infrastructure. We undergo regular audits, annual penetration testing, and continuous security monitoring to maintain these standards. It’s part of our broader commitment to infrastructure that scales with your success. Built for Gaming at Scale Game backends handle millions of concurrent players, real-time multiplayer sessions, and sensitive player data. Our security controls have been designed specifically for the unique demands of game infrastructure: Multi-cloud resilience across AWS and GCP Zero-downtime deployments to maintain 24/7 game operations Encrypted data storage and transmission for player data protection Comprehensive access controls with multi-factor authentication Get the Report Both current and prospective customers can request: Our SOC 2 Type II report from Johanson Group LLP Annual penetration testing results Due to the nature of the details included in the SOC 2 report, please contact us at hello@heroiclabs.com to acquire these documents.

title: Experience Ultimate Realism with the VelocityOne Race KD3's Direct Drive 3.2Nm Force Feedback Motor
summary: Experience the precision of the VelocityOne Race KD3, a Direct Drive Racing Wheel powered by a 3.2Nm Force Feedback Motor for unparalleled realism and c...
body_text: The difference between victory and defeat in sim racing often comes down to milliseconds and the subtle feedback your wheel provides. The VelocityOne Race KD3 delivers that critical edge with its advanced Direct Drive Racing Wheel technology, featuring a custom 3.2Nm Force Feedback Motor that transforms virtual racing into an authentic driving experience. Whether you're battling for pole position in Formula races or navigating tight corners in rally stages, the VelocityOne Race KD3 provides the precision and realism that serious sim racers demand . This isn't just another racing controller; it's your gateway to Realistic racing simulation that responds exactly like the real thing. Revolutionary Direct Drive Technology: The Heart of the KD3 Direct Drive 3.2Nm Motor: Precision Without Compromise The VelocityOne Race KD3 features Turtle Beach's proprietary K: Drive™ direct-drive force feedback motor , delivering 3.2Nm of peak torque with ultra-low latency response. Unlike belt-driven systems that can experience up to 20:1 gear ratios, causing force feedback detail loss , the direct drive design connects the steering wheel directly to the motor shaft, ensuring every road texture, tire grip change, and track detail reaches your hands with absolute precision. This direct connection eliminates the mechanical play and delay found in belt-driven systems. As sim racing experts note , belt-driven wheelbases can lose high-frequency force feedback details due to belt absorption, while direct drive systems provide true 1:1 force feedback without mechanical filtering. Superior Response and Precision The KD3's direct-drive design provides up to 2,160 degrees of customizable wheel rotation, allowing you to dial in the exact steering response for different racing disciplines—from tight Formula-style setups to full lock-to-lock rally configurations. This adjustability ensures optimal performance whether you're piloting GT cars around Silverstone or tackling the Nürburgring's demanding corners. The 3.2Nm Force Feedback Motor represents the entry point to direct drive technology, providing enough strength to communicate critical vehicle dynamics while remaining manageable during extended racing sessions. This torque level sits perfectly for Sim Racing Setup enthusiasts transitioning from belt-driven wheels to direct drive precision. Advanced Components for Ultimate Control Magnetic Paddle Shifters: Engineering Excellence The VelocityOne Race KD3 features two magnetic paddle shifters that provide smooth, reliable gear changes across any vehicle type. The magnetic technology ensures consistent actuation without the wear associated with mechanical switches, delivering precise shifts whether you're heel-and-toeing through chicanes or quick-shifting down straights. These Magnetic Paddle Shifters exemplify Turtle Beach's commitment to quality engineering, ensuring reliable performance through thousands of racing sessions. Customizable Hall-Effect Pedal Assembly The included adjustable aluminum pedal set features hall-effect sensors in both throttle and brake pedals, providing reliable, drift-free operation that maintains accuracy throughout the product's lifetime. The hall-effect technology eliminates the degradation common in potentiometer-based pedals, ensuring a consistent response even after extensive use. Unlike entry-level racing wheels that use basic sensors, the KD3's hall-effect technology delivers professional-grade accuracy that serious Xbox Racing Accessories enthusiasts demand. Race Management Display and Real-Time Performance Tuning On-the-Fly Customization The full-color Race Management Display™ allows real-time configuration of up to five onboard memory profiles, including force feedback response, control mapping, and vehicle-specific settings. This advanced digital dashboard provides immediate access to critical adjustments without leaving your racing session. The Race Management Display can show real-time race telemetry data and integrate with popular racing titles to display authentic dashboard information directly on the wheel. This integration maximizes immersion by replicating the data displays found in real race cars, bringing professional-level functionality to your PC Racing Wheel setup. Seamless Profile Management Each of the five memory profiles can be customized for different racing scenarios, whether you need precise feedback for Formula racing, stronger resistance for GT cars, or specific settings for rally stages. This flexibility makes the KD3 adaptable to any racing discipline without compromising performance. Modular Racing Hardware and Expandable Ecosystem VelocityOne Tuner App Integration The VelocityOne™ Tuner companion app, available for Xbox, PC, iOS, and Android devices, provides comprehensive customization options for force feedback strength, control mapping, and performance adjustments. The app also handles firmware updates to ensure optimal performance as racing games evolve. This software integration represents Turtle Beach's holistic approach to gaming peripherals, ensuring your racing setup integrates seamlessly with the broader gaming ecosystem. Expandable Design Philosophy The KD3 wheelbase features a quick-release wheel design compatible with other VelocityOne™ wheels, like the F-RX formula wheel . Four USB-C expansion ports allow connection of accessories such as the VelocityOne™ Multi-Shift shifter. This modular approach means your Sim Racing Setup can evolve with your skills and preferences. Start with the KD3's included wheel and pedals, then add specialized components as your racing interests expand. VelocityOne™ F-RX Formula Wheel View Product Universal Compatibility, Xbox Racing Accessories and Beyond Multi-Platform Performance The VelocityOne Race KD3 works seamlessly across Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and Windows 10/11 PCs, ensuring compatibility with your entire gaming ecosystem. This universal support means you can experience Realistic racing simulation, whether you prefer console convenience or PC flexibility. For complete gaming immersion, pair the KD3 with premium audio solutions from Turtle Beach's headset collection to hear every engine note and tire squeal with crystal clarity. Professional-Grade Mounting Options The wheelbase includes integrated threaded inserts for permanent sim rig mounting, plus a convenient table clamp for temporary setups. The wheelbase features an adjustable angle, allowing flat positioning for Formula-style racing or angled mounting for traditional road car configurations. This mounting flexibility makes the KD3 suitable for everything from dedicated sim racing rooms to shared gaming spaces where equipment must be stored between sessions. Technical Specifications and Build Quality Durable, Racing-Grade Materials The VelocityOne Race KD3 features a removable, soft-textured steering wheel with durable, racing-grade materials designed to withstand intensive use. The wheelbase weighs 3.30kg (7.28lbs), providing stability during aggressive racing sessions, while the pedal set weighs 2.00kg (4.41lbs) with dimensions of 415mm x 273mm x 224mm. Complete Setup Out of the Box The KD3 system includes everything needed for immediate racing: direct-drive force feedback wheel, adjustable aluminum pedals, mounting hardware, and all necessary cables. This authentic, complete racing setup eliminates the need for additional purchases to start racing. Why Direct Drive Matters in Sim Racing Setup Technical Advantages Over Belt-Drive Systems Research shows that belt-driven racing wheels experience force feedback detail loss through mechanical intermediaries, while direct drive systems provide true 1:1 force feedback without mechanical filtering or delay. This precision allows racers to feel subtle grip changes, track surface variations, and vehicle dynamics that belt-driven systems simply cannot communicate. The result is improved car control, faster lap times, and more consistent performance across different racing conditions. Long-Term Reliability and Value Direct drive systems feature fewer moving parts than belt or gear-driven alternatives, reducing wear points and improving long-term reliability. With no belts to stretch or gears to wear, the KD3 maintains consistent performance throughout its operational life, making it a sound investment for serious sim racers. Professional Training Applications Training and Development Tool Professional racing drivers increasingly use sim racing for off-season training and track familiarization. The KD3's 3.2Nm Force Feedback Motor provides feedback detail sufficient for skill development, making it valuable for drivers learning racecraft fundamentals and track layouts. The wheel's compatibility with professional simulation software ensures it meets the demands of both entertainment and serious training applications. The Complete Turtle Beach Gaming Experience Integrated Gaming Ecosystem Turtle Beach's commitment to gaming excellence extends across its entire product portfolio. The company's comprehensive controller lineup includes specialized options for every gaming scenario, while its keyboard collection provides the precision input needed for sim racing setup customization. Audio Integration for Complete Immersion Racing isn't just about visual and tactile feedback—audio plays a crucial role in competitive performance. Turtle Beach's premium headsets provide the directional audio cues needed to hear approaching competitors, engine strain, and tire lock-up warnings that separate podium finishers from the rest of the field. Investment in Racing Excellence The VelocityOne Race KD3 represents Turtle Beach's commitment to bringing professional-grade simulation technology to serious gaming enthusiasts. Priced at $449.99, it provides an accessible entry point to direct drive technology without compromising on quality or features. Every element of the VelocityOne Race KD3 , from its direct drive motor to its magnetic paddle shifters, is engineered to deliver the realism and precision that transform virtual racing into authentic driving experiences. When thousandths of a second determine race outcomes, having equipment that responds exactly as intended makes all the difference. Step into the driver's seat with confidence. The VelocityOne Race KD3 doesn't just simulate racing, it delivers it with the precision and reliability that only Turtle Beach's engineering excellence can provide. FAQ What makes the VelocityOne Race KD3's direct drive motor unique? The KD3 features a custom K: Drive™ direct-drive motor with 3.2Nm of peak torque that connects directly to the steering wheel without belts or gears. This eliminates mechanical filtering and provides true 1:1 force feedback with ultra-low latency response, representing an accessible entry point to direct drive technology. Is the KD3 compatible with Xbox and PC racing games? Yes, the VelocityOne Race KD3 is officially licensed for Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and works with Windows 10/11 PCs. It's compatible with popular racing titles across both platforms and includes the VelocityOne Tuner app for optimization across Xbox, PC, iOS, and Android devices. How does force feedback improve racing realism? Force feedback communicates road texture, tire grip levels, vehicle weight transfer, and track conditions through the steering wheel. The KD3's direct drive system preserves all these details without the mechanical filtering found in belt-driven wheels, providing more accurate car control and improved racing performance. What customization options does the KD3 offer? The KD3 includes a Race Management Display for real-time adjustments, five onboard memory profiles, customizable force feedback strength, adjustable wheel rotation up to 2,160 degrees, and comprehensive app-based tuning through the VelocityOne Tuner companion app available on multiple platforms. What accessories can be used with the VelocityOne Race KD3? The KD3 features a quick-release wheel system compatible with other VelocityOne wheels like the F-RX formula wheel, four USB-C expansion ports for accessories like the Multi-Shift shifter, and integration with the broader VelocityOne racing ecosystem for modular expansion as your racing interests grow.

title: How Styles in QuickFrame AI Beta Supercharge Video Generation
summary: Explore QuickFrame AI (beta) Styles, your creative launchpads for turning inspiration into studio-quality video ads in minutes.
body_text: Creative When you first click into QuickFrame AI beta, you’ll notice something that feels a bit like walking into a downtown art gallery: a collection of Styles, each one with its own unique canvas of motion and mood, energy and story. These Styles are more than templates. They’re creative launchpads. Each one is built to set a specific tone, pacing, and visual world for your ad, from sweeping cinematic vistas to bright, family-friendly kitchens. And with just a few words in your prompt, you can bend them toward your brand, your message, and your products. How to Pick a Style Choosing a style all depends on you — and what you want to do. Think of Styles as the starting point for your story. Each one offers its own visual tone, emotional energy, and production aesthetic. Some are high-gloss and cinematic; others are bright and playful; a few lean into grit and intensity. With QF AI beta, you’re free to generate and test-drive multiple Styles to see what feels right for your brand and your offering. Maybe your brand fits best in a sunlit kitchen; maybe it shines in a neon-lit gym. The beauty of this platform is that you can find out in minutes, not months. And if none of the preset Styles feel quite right for what you had in mind, don’t worry! You can always Create Your Own Style, where you get to define every scene, every character, and every beat of your ad through precision prompting. Think of it as your open workspace where your team’s creativity can take the lead and produce something truly original. Now let’s move from theory to practice. Your goal isn’t to find the perfect Style right away. It’s to play, explore, and, ultimately, create. Here are three Styles you can explore in QuickFrame AI beta, along with a few ideas for how to fine-tune them with prompts. Block Party Vibes Style Description Block Party Vibes radiates warmth, connection, and everyday authenticity. Set against the golden-hour glow of a suburban neighborhood, this Style captures the spirit of a local community — casual, cheerful, and effortlessly welcoming. With soft acoustic guitar, candid performances, and bright color grading, it turns ordinary neighborhood moments into something cinematic. Style Analysis The story unfolds through a series of small but meaningful moments. It opens with a neighbor waving to camera, framed by tables filled with snacks, balloons, and colorful bunting fluttering in the sunlight. The tone is friendly and conversational, instantly disarming as if the viewer has just been invited to the block party. We move through scenes that celebrate connection: a woman gesturing toward a community pinboard covered in local flyers; a neighbor chatting on a porch; a teenager speaking from a park while families and a dog fill the background. Every frame feels lived-in and genuine. The pacing is relaxed but purposeful, letting viewers feel the rhythm of suburban life. The acoustic score adds warmth without sentimentality, carrying the viewer through to the final barbecue scene — a backyard framed by string lights and laughter, plates passed between friends — ending on a feeling that’s equal parts neighborly and nostalgic. Why It Works Block Party Vibes succeeds because it feels real. The camerawork, natural characters, and warm palette combine to create an authenticity that builds trust in the brand and product. The composition and tone feel genuine, not staged, making it both approachable and aspirational, ideal for brands that want to highlight togetherness, inclusion, and neighborhood pride. Perfect for community-driven apps, real estate, small businesses, and home services, this Style celebrates what connects us. How to Make It Your Own This Style shows how QF AI beta can turn simple, everyday moments into something cinematic — proof that the most powerful stories often begin just down the block. If you’re a local tech or service brand , prompt QF AI beta to anchor the story in your product: “Show neighbors using an app to plan a local event, like a neighborhood cleanup; replace block party with neighbors meeting up in the morning to get started.” If you’re in real estate or home services , prompt: “Focus on friendly neighbors chatting in driveways with a realtor; maintain warm golden lighting and conversational tone.” If you’re in education or nonprofit outreach , test: “Feature volunteers organizing a community fundraiser; keep warm afternoon lighting and conversational dialogue and tone.” Want to go deeper on best practices for writing prompts? The QuickFrame AI Beta Prompting Handbook breaks down the creative building blocks for effective prompts, with tips and tricks on applying them to your QF AI beta video ads. Urban Athletes Style Description Urban Athletes celebrates motion, focus, and collective strength. This Style captures the heartbeat of a city alive with ambition. It follows a diverse group of people, from solo runners to group athletes, training across city streets, gyms, and outdoor courts. It’s kinetic, emotional, and a visual anthem to grit, focus, and the raw energy of collective momentum. Style Analysis From the opening seconds, Urban Athletes is pure motion, every shot choreographed with rhythm. Pulsing electronic beats kick off as the camera bobs up and down, mimicking the breath of the athletes each scene focuses on, from someone giving his team encouragement on the court, to a runner catching his breath on a city street, to a group of friends high-fiving under neon lights after a workout. Every frame glistens with sweat and light. The editing mirrors the rhythm of a workout — bursts of energy followed by moments to catch your breath. The music reinforces the urgency to keep moving forward, and as the video builds toward its climax, scenes of determination give way to a moment of triumph, culminating in a sense of earned accomplishment. Why It Works Urban Athletes thrives on authenticity and drive. Everything (dialogue, sound, lighting, pacing) is built to make you feel these athletes’ exertion. It’s a natural fit for fitness, sportswear, and wellness brands looking to celebrate physical performance. Still, the underlying narrative of persistence and teamwork easily extends to gaming, tech, education, and more. How to Make It Your Own This is one of those Styles that proves QF AI beta isn’t just making ads — it’s matching energy to emotion. If you’re a fitness or apparel brand , prompt QF AI beta to personalize the environment: “Replace city backdrops with coastal trails; keep fast-paced rhythm and dynamic lighting.” If you’re in tech or gaming , reframe the tone: “Use the same pacing and intensity, but shift focus to the competitive world of e-sports.” If you’re education or career-focused , adjust the metaphor: “Show people collaborating under pressure, mirroring the same energy and determination, but swapping athletes for office workers.” Shared Horizon Style Description Shared Horizon captures the quiet awe of wanderlust and the profound bond created by sharing life-changing experiences with those closest to you. Sweeping and cinematic, this Style conveys the feeling of standing on the edge of possibility, where the world opens up and every destination feels within reach. With expansive landscapes, serene pacing, and an evocative mood, this Style creates a sense of wonder that feels both deeply personal and visually grand. Style Analysis Shared Horizon opens with a sweeping sunrise across mountain peaks, the horizon painted in gold. A couple stands at an overlook, coffee cups steaming beside a travel guidebook. The visuals are natural yet cinematic: golden hues and elegant compositions that mirror the calmness of stepping into nature. The pacing is deliberate, unhurried, letting each moment breathe. As a soft orchestral score builds, every shot works to balance intimacy and scale: it’s as much about the people in the frame as it is about the world beyond them. Why It Works This Style leans heavily on tone and atmosphere — warm lighting, cinematic composition, and natural sound design that feels like exhaling after a long work week. But it resonates because it taps into universal emotions like aspiration, wonder, and connection. That makes it well-suited for any brand that sells discovery, from travel and hospitality to wellness or outdoor apparel. But its core message of possibility also makes it a powerful foundation for finance, education, tech, or any brand that helps people do (and discover) more. How to Make It Your Own At its core, Shared Horizon is about new perspectives — and QF AI beta helps you transform that perspective into a story that’s unmistakably your own. If you’re a travel or adventure brand , prompt QF AI beta to localize the journey: “Show a couple overlooking a forest at sunset; maintain cinematic pacing and natural light.” If you’re in hospitality or leisure , prompt: “Swap the mountain view for an island getaway, and replace travel guides with resort brochures; add subtle luxury cues like soft linens or champagne.” If you’re in finance or consulting , shift the lens: “Reimagine the overlook as a modern city rooftop at sunrise, swapping out backpackers for office workers.” From Inspiration to Creation With QuickFrame AI beta, you’re not choosing between creativity and control — you’re getting both. The beauty of Styles is that they don’t box you in: they open doors. Each one gives you a head start with professional-grade storytelling, ready for you to tweak, reimagine, and make entirely yours through precision prompting. Just start with a Style, add your URL to build your brand profile, make tweaks with prompts, and then step back and watch QuickFrame AI beta bring your story to life. Your next great ad is just a click away. Create your account to get started for free with QuickFrame AI beta today.

+Oscar Builds on Innovative Member Engagement Tool | Press | Oscar
summary: +Oscar Builds on Innovative Member Engagement Tool to Further Drive Positive Outcomes for Members and Clients
body_text: Oscar Health, Inc. (“Oscar”) (NYSE: OSCR), the first health insurance company built on a full stack technology platform, announced today the launch of its Next Best Actions engine, a messaging framework that simplifies member communications. Built within +Oscar’s existing Campaign Builder technology, the Next Best Actions engine identifies unique opportunities at the individual level and follows a targeted messaging hierarchy to drive behavior change. “Since our founding, we have been providing members with what we think is a unique experience,” said Mario Schlosser, Co-Founder and CEO. “Because we control our tech-stack from end-to-end, we’re able to build tools that allow us to respond to consumer pain-points and provide a less complicated experience. This flexibility helps us drive better outcomes for our members and allows us to quickly make this technology available to our +Oscar clients who want to leverage it for their audiences.” +Oscar’s next generation Next Best Actions framework harnesses behavioral science principles to increase campaign conversion rates by ensuring that members or patients are only engaged with the single, highest priority action for them at any one time. Too often, members disengage from important healthcare decisions due to overwhelming or irrelevant information –– the Next Best Actions engine was built to challenge this issue. The engine has been integrated within +Oscar’s Campaign Builder to provide a seamless communication experience. From a functionality perspective, the Campaign Builder eliminates decision fatigue and enables members to focus on the most important decision or action. Members can receive communications through multiple channels, including: email, in-app messages, push notifications, SMS, letters, faxes, and phone calls. Since its launch, almost 50% of members have engaged in a campaign communication with engagement rates of 48%. The prioritization framework has also helped drive a 20% increase in member engagement. All this while Oscar has dramatically increased the volume of campaigns targeting members by 40%. To learn more about how +Oscar is helping payers, providers and disruptors better manage risk while driving improved efficiency, growth, and superior consumer engagement, please visit hioscar.com/plus-oscar. About Oscar Health Oscar Health, Inc. (“Oscar”) is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving its members. At Oscar, our mission is to make a healthier life accessible and affordable for all. Headquartered in New York City, Oscar has been challenging the health care system's status quo since our founding in 2012. The company’s member-first philosophy and innovative approach to care has earned us the trust of over one million members as of March 31, 2022. We offer Individual & Family, Small Group and Medicare Advantage plans, and +Oscar, our full stack technology platform to enable others within the provider and payor space. Our vision is to refactor health care to make good care cost less. Refactor is a term used in software engineering that means to improve the design, structure, and implementation of the software, while preserving its functionality. At Oscar, we take this definition a step further. We improve our members’ experience by building trust through deep engagement, personalized guidance, and rapid iteration.

title: Aldeyra Therapeutics Announces Positive Results from Phase 2 Clinical Trial in Alcohol-Associated Hepatitis, Focuses RASP Product Candidate Pipeline on Next-Generation Molecules
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Aldeyra Therapeutics, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_text: PDF Version Relative to Baseline, Signal-Finding Molecule ADX‑629 Demonstrated Statistically Significant Improvement in Liver Function in Patients with Alcohol-Associated Hepatitis RASP Modulator Product Candidate Pipeline Focused on ADX‑248 and ADX‑246 for Dermatologic, Metabolic, and Retinal Immune-Mediated Diseases Cash Runway Extended into the Second Half of 2027 LEXINGTON, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 28, 2025-- Aldeyra Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALDX) (Aldeyra), a biotechnology company devoted to discovering and developing innovative therapies designed to treat immune-mediated diseases, today announced achievement of statistically significant improvement in liver function in patients treated with ADX-629, an investigational new drug candidate, and focused the RASP modulator product candidate pipeline on next-generation molecules ADX-248 and ADX-246. This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251028764760/en/ ADX-629, a signal-finding RASP modulator for proof-of-concept clinical testing, was administered orally for one month in a single-arm, multicenter Phase 2 clinical trial in four patients with mild to moderate alcohol-associated hepatitis. Relative to baseline, statistically significant improvement was observed in clinically relevant objective markers of hepatic function and inflammation, including the Model for End-Stage Liver Disease (MELD) score (P=0.001), triglyceride levels (P<0.0001), and levels of C-Reactive Protein (P<0.0001). No serious adverse events were reported, and no adverse events were deemed related to ADX-629. “Consistent with clinical trials in patients with atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, chronic cough, and asthma, the orally administered RASP modulator ADX-629, relative to baseline, demonstrated activity in improving liver function and reducing inflammation in patients with mild to moderate alcohol-associated hepatitis, a chronic and challenging disease that proves difficult to manage in many cases,” stated Todd C. Brady, M.D., Ph.D., President and Chief Executive Officer of Aldeyra. “The positive results announced today, which we look forward to sharing in more detail in the future, mark the culmination of our clinical proof of concept with ADX-629, as we focus our pipeline on next-generation RASP modulators ADX-248 and ADX-246 for the treatment of immune-mediated diseases.” The RASP modulator product candidate pipeline was updated: Based on Phase 1 clinical trial results generated to date in healthy volunteers, which suggest high levels of exposure following once-daily oral dosing, RASP modulator ADX-248 replaced ADX-743 for the treatment of metabolic inflammation, including obesity and hypertriglyceridemia; anticipated timing for the filing of an Investigational New Drug (IND) application was updated to 2026. Based on favorable results in an animal model of a dry form of age-related macular degeneration (dry AMD), RASP modulator ADX-246 replaced ADX-631 for the treatment of dry AMD; anticipated timing for the filing of an IND application was updated to 2026. Clinical development of ADX-629 was discontinued, pending further investigator-sponsored clinical testing in Sjögren-Larsson Syndrome, a RASP-mediated inborn error of metabolism. As a result of the pipeline updates, projected operational runway based on cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities has been extended into the second half of 2027. “In addition to our late-stage, pre-commercial programs in dry eye disease, allergic conjunctivitis, primary vitreoretinal lymphoma, and retinitis pigmentosa, Aldeyra is committed to developing a robust pipeline of novel therapeutics in a fiscally prudent manner to maintain growth,” continued Dr. Brady. About Aldeyra Aldeyra Therapeutics is a biotechnology company devoted to discovering innovative therapies designed to treat immune-mediated diseases. Our approach is to develop pharmaceuticals that modulate protein systems, instead of directly inhibiting or activating single protein targets, with the goal of optimizing multiple pathways at once while minimizing toxicity. Our product candidates include RASP (reactive aldehyde species) modulators ADX‑248, ADX-246, and chemically related molecules for the potential treatment of systemic and retinal immune-mediated diseases. Our late-stage product candidates are reproxalap, a RASP modulator for the potential treatment of dry eye disease and allergic conjunctivitis, and ADX-2191, a novel formulation of intravitreal methotrexate for the potential treatment of primary vitreoretinal lymphoma and retinitis pigmentosa.
